set.body:
Type: implementation or qualification task
Work key: O02.2
Program plan: docs/institutional-pilot-epics.md
Core plan: docs/core-hardening-plan.md
Accountable role (person unassigned): Operations engineer with institutional operator
Scope: Qualify H06.1’s implemented metrics/alerts on the selected institutional deployment, with named escalation/acknowledgment; local test-receiver evidence cannot close this task.

Work kind: mixed
Acceptance gate: O02 (bd-01M4W40K6BGH2A78J8820FP8M6)

Acceptance criteria:
1. Measure database/pool pressure, request/stream concurrency, operation/lease backlog, storage use, integrity failures and backup/journal lag with bounded label cardinality.
2. Configure warning/critical thresholds and an escalation destination from the deployment profile; alert payloads contain no private data.
3. Inject each launch-critical condition and verify actual alert delivery/acknowledgment; dashboard existence alone does not qualify alerting.

Verification: Metric fixtures plus redacted staging alert/ack receipts; named operator validates escalation.
Expected evidence: docs/evidence/institutional-pilot/O02.2/receipt.json
Evidence fields: exact source/artifact and configuration identity; commands or human procedure and observed outcomes; fixtures/data scope and environment; acceptance-criterion results, negative cases and limitations; reviewer/acceptance evidence when the task requires institutional input

External inputs:
- Institutional alert destination for final delivery check

Source/contracts:
- modules/service/src/main/scala/sanctity/app/ApiServer.scala
- modules/objects/src/main/scala/sanctity/objects/FileBlobStore.scala
- modules/application/src/main/scala/sanctity/application/DurableImports.scala
- docs/core-hardening-plan.md

Blocked by:
- O02.1: bd-01M4W5P86V3ZV697KZ1F85XFM4
- H06.1: bd-01M4X8MB2G63FDYPV1DPX759X1
- SITE01.3: bd-01M4W5P4DYBM03CDGZ6AGB9DVP

Completion: satisfy every criterion with source/artifact/configuration-bound observed evidence. Integrity, unauthorized disclosure, resurrected authority or false success block release. Local engineering and simulated provider/component-loss evidence do not close real institutional/provider/human/physical-host-loss gates. Existing completed work is not reopened or relabeled by this planning revision.
set.title: O02.2: Add operational metrics and tested alert delivery
